issues: 占位文案「Your title」小字（约 1/8 画宽）居中在纯黑底上，画面空、没有层级
括号与文字字号接近、没有强调色，括号的符号感很弱
弹开曲线短促，文字不是被括号"拉"出来，揭示瞬间就完成
没有任何背景光、配套信息，落定后就是一张静态小字卡
changes: look = midnight 开发者发布会字卡：等宽 300px 电光蓝花括号（带泛光）夹住 164px 800 字重「Edge Functions」，眉题 `// new in Nimbus 3` + 副标逐词浮现
开场第 0 帧是闪烁的输入光标，6f 被一对内缘相贴的 0.4 倍「{}」硬切替换，先建立符号
主动作改物理弹簧（≈9% 过冲、一次回弹）：幕布半宽 = (HALF−内缘)·ex·sc、括号中心再外移内缘·sc，clip 宽度严格 = 2x；标题宽度贴满 1224px 内腔，拉到头才露全
快速段括号按水平速度加方向性运动模糊，泛光峰值跟着过冲走再回落；落定后字距 −0.05→−0.03em 松弛
背景：编辑器点阵网格（径向渐隐）+ 顶光 + 地平线光带 + 随弹开展宽的冷光反射；尾段 1→1.012 缓推，时长 114→120f
issuesEn: Placeholder 'Your title' in small type (about 1/8 of frame width) centred on flat black — empty frame, no hierarchy
Braces and text are nearly the same size with no accent colour, so the symbol barely registers
The expand curve is short and the text isn't pulled open by the braces — the reveal is over instantly
No background light or supporting info; once settled it's a static small title card
changesEn: Look = midnight developer-launch title card: 300px mono electric-blue braces with glow framing a 164px 800-weight 'Edge Functions', with a mono eyebrow '// new in Nimbus 3' and a word-by-word subline
Frame 0 is a blinking text caret; at 6f it hard-cuts to a 0.4× '{}' pair touching at their inner edges, establishing the symbol first

Main move is a physical spring (~9% overshoot, one bounce): curtain half-width = (HALF−inner)·ex·sc, brace centres offset by inner·sc, clip width exactly 2x; the title fills the 1224px cavity so it's only fully revealed at full stretch
Braces get directional motion blur from their horizontal speed, glow peaks with the overshoot then decays; letter-spacing relaxes −0.05→−0.03em after landing
Backdrop: editor dot grid with radial falloff, top key light, horizon band and a cool reflection that widens with the braces; slow 1→1.012 push at the end, duration 114→120f
